description: VP37 actuator drive and its measurement: low-side MOSFET PWM channels of the quantity and timing actuators, the source shunt of the quantity MOSFET, the supply divider and the drive enable. Each firmware wires its own pins; the parts and values are those of every stage of this type.

shuntOhms.description: Low-side shunt in the quantity MOSFET source.

supplyDividerHighOhms.description: Supply divider resistor between the supply and the ADC pin.

supplyDividerLowOhms.description: Supply divider resistor between the ADC pin and ground.
